events.title: Lich Lords Demo Release!

events.title: New Trailer Announcement
events.summary: Hello!We've just released a new trailer for Lich Lords, showing many of the new changes we've made since we released our playtest. This features new bosses, skills/spells, improved combat, and more. Check it out on our Steam page now! Many of these changes have come as a direct result of the feedback we've received from the playtest. events.title: Lich Lords - Beta Testing Announcement!
events.summary: One day, you awake to find the warmth of your human body and flesh gone, replaced with cold bone. Your memory is a blur of vague glimpses of humanity. You find yourself in a strange, eldritch realm. You have become a Lich, and now you're in an endless cycle where Liches fight to the death for supremacy, until only one remains - the "Lich Lord" - only for the cycle to begin again...Hello!Beta testing for Lich Lords will begin next month!
